programmes.d: When Frankini announces his plan to unmask Kid Danger and Captain Man, Charlotte, Schwoz, Jasper and Piper must snap into action to stop him.
Henry receives an invitation to Swellview's most exclusive restaurant, and decides to bring his boss, Ray.
When a dangerous piñata winds up at a child's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover to step in before it is too late.
When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works.
After Jasper is lauded for being a local hero, Henry becomes jealous that Kid Danger is the one getting all the thanks.
Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to prevent the rare Neal Diamond from being stolen.
Captain Man tries to boost his image by holding a contest where three winners get a tour of his secret lair.

Convinced that their scrapbook isn't good enough for Dad's birthday, the Loud kids seek out the perfect gift; Lily hears the parents mention ice cream if the kids are good, so she uses baby smarts to avert sibling disasters.

Lori takes a job as a waitress at Dad's restaurant, but it turns out that serving is harder than she anticipated; spurred on by a classmate's mocking about Charles, Lana decides to train him to compete in a local dog show.

Dad and Lincoln get on "Legends of the Hidden Temple" and cannot wait to for a whole day of father-and-son bonding; Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he decides to take them to the mall.

The family embarks on a reading challenge at the library, but Lola refuses to participate; when Lincoln discovers the first page of his baby book is blank, he worries his parents are hiding something.
Lincoln has to get his sisters out the door so he can be on time for school; Lincoln holds the deciding vote for the family vacation.
Lola realizes that double the cuteness could help her break into show business, so she teams up with Lily; Lori vows to make up for lost time in her senior year.
Lincoln uses sound-canceling ear buds to try and drown out his sisters; after Lynn and Lucy get in a fight, Lincoln agrees to let Lynn bunk in his room for one night.
Lynn's extreme sports superstitions cause chaos; the kids try to convince Mom and Dad that they still play with their childhood toys.

To divert the attention of his helicopter dads, Clyde arranges for an exchange student to stay with them; Lola takes a timid new classmate under her wing and gives her a social butterfly transformation.

The Loud family believe that they are safe from pranks on April Fool's Day because prankster Luan is away at camp; when the children discover that their father is not at his old job anymore, they begin to worry it might be their fault.

Mom takes over when Lucy quits the writing club at school due to the by-the-book way Huggins runs the club; Luna and Sam embark on a challenge taking place across Royal Woods and discover they have less in common than they thought.

Lynn finds an unexpected TV sports-watching buddy in the family's next-door neighbor, Mr. Grouse; when Lisa realizes that Pop Pop won't be around forever, she turns to science to ensure his longevity.
SpongeBob thinks Mr. Krabs is a robot; SpongeBob and Patrick care for an abandoned baby clam.
SpongeBob blows bubbles; SpongeBob accidentally rips his pants while trying to impress Sandy Cheeks at Mussel Beach.

Rock, paper and scissors meet another trio with their same names; the trio tries to prove they're not the worst; rock and paper try to end a feud between scissors and a powerful magician before her magic ruins their lives.
When Pencil comes over to watch a horror movie, Paper worries he is too scared to handle it; there's a light wind, and Paper is far from home, so Rock and Scissors must try to save him.
Crocker tries to trigger Sparky with a secret word; Catman confuses Sparky with his arch-nemesis, Dogman.
After making a deal with Dad, Crocker becomes best friends with Dinkleberg; Timmy wishes for 5,000 Timmys for the Planet of the Dads.
Timmy wishes that Sparky could become human; Timmy wishes that Mr. Crocker would disappear, and Mr. Crocker becomes invisible.
Timmy, his father and the fairies get stuck in a board game created by Cosmo; Timmy wishes that Sparky would get a chance to be heroic.
After Dad rejects his offer to buy Sparky, Dad's boss makes his job miserable; Timmy wishes that his ancestors had different careers.
When Dad believes that everyone finds him boring, Timmy wishes his life was like an action movie; Timmy and his parents are invited to a country club.
Timmy makes a wish to be "emo" and stops caring about everything; Timmy and the fairies have to rid his home of fairy dust.
Foop and Poof must take care of an egg for a school project; Timmy's father becomes a news anchor when Chet Ubetcha quits his job; Timmy must get Chet back in order to save the city.
Foop becomes Vicky's anti-fairy godparent and the pair begin to terrorize Timmy and the children of Dimmsdale.
Timmy wishes the park animals would clean up after themselves; Timmy helps his mother make a viral video.
Poof goes through the terrible twos; Timmy wishes for the world's coolest smartphone.
Crocker seeks out a new source of magic from Timmy's house; Timmy wishes that he were smarter than everyone else.
Timmy wishes Mr. Dinkleberg would replace Dad as Squirrelly Scout leader; amnesiac Cosmo believes he is Dad's genie.
Timmy adopts a mischievous fairy dog.
Timmy's parents discover that he has fairy godparents.
Timmy's enemies form a league in order to annihilate him.
Timmy's previous wish for a Planet of Dads comes back to haunt him when the Dads come to steal his mother away.

While participating in the school play, Poof and Foop compete to win the affection of Goldie Goldenglow.
Dad turns Timmy's room into a surveillance center in order to prove that his neighbor is evil.
Timmy's father turns their home into a farm; Mr. Crocker tries to expose monsters on a web show.
Timmy wishes for 12 hours of pure darkness; the Turners are stranded on a deserted island.
Timmy borrows Mark Chang's Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie's costume party; Cosmo must enforce the rules when Jorgen comes down with the Trick-ups.
Timmy wishes that his mother were a better cook; the Turners win a trip to space.
Dad goes back to school in Timmy's fifth grade; Timmy steals Jorgen's grandmother's secret recipe for brownies.
Timmy helps his parents relive their days as ghostbusters; Timmy wishes his parents were the best surfers ever while on vacation in Hawaii.
SpongeBob tries to convince a bouncer that he is tough enough for the Salty Spitoon; Squidward's archenemy returns.
SpongeBob applies for a job as a fry cook at Krusty Krab; Squidward's lawn; SpongeBob meets Sandy Cheeks.
Patrick and SpongeBob learn to tie their shoes; Squidward is in charge of the Krusty Krab.
Plankton decides to start a new business selling trinkets and souvenir gifts; Gary starts biting everyone in town.
SpongeBob discovers that Squidward has never actually tried a Krabby patty; a bully threatens SpongeBob.
SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward buy Mr. Krabs a new mattress; Plankton sues Mr. Krabs after falling at the Krusty Krab.
SpongeBob micromanages an all-out shindig for the denizens of Bikini Bottom.
Granny Tentacles helps Squidward collect his paper delivery money from Cecil; the Star family house runs away from home.
Patrick's uncontrollable drooling gets out of hand and mouth; a shape-shifting alien runs loose in the Star home.
When Henry gets an unexpected side effect from going through the Densitizer, he must hide it from his family while the gang works to help him return to normal.
